gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests for {@link Frequency#getCount}, {@link Frequency#getSumFreq}, {@link Frequency#getCumFreq}, {@link Frequency#getPct}, and {@link Frequency#getCumPct} acro
ADDED i2: Verifies count, cumulative freq, and clear behaviour for Long values.
ADDED i3: Add: 1L appears 3 times (via constant and literal), 2L appears once
ADDED i4: Cumulative frequencies: values sorted ascending as 1L, 2L
ADDED i5: Verifies case-sensitive String frequency: each variant ("one", "One", "oNe") is treated as a distinct value.
ADDED i6: Only exact "one" matches; "One" and "oNe" are different keys
ADDED i7: Sorted order (natural): "One" < "Z" < "oNe" < "one" (uppercase letters before lower)
ADDED i8: Verifies count, cumulative percentage, and percentage for Integer values.
ADDED i9: Add: 1 appears 3 times, 2 appears once, -1 appears once → 5 total
ADDED i11: Sorted order: -1, 1, 2 → cumulative counts: 1, 4, 5
ADDED i12: Verifies case-insensitive String frequency: "one", "One", and "oNe" all map to the same bucket when using {@link String#CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER}.
ADDED i13: Two distinct buckets: "one" (3 obs) and "Z" (1 obs); "Z" is the last → cumPct = 1
ADDED i14: Verifies Character frequency: checks NaN behaviour on an empty table, then count and cumulative percentage after adding 'a','b','c','d'.
ADDED i15: Empty table: counts are 0; percentages are NaN (undefined with no observations)
ADDED i16: Add one observation each of 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd' → 4 total, sorted a < b < c < d
